instruction: Using only the standalone stem, independently free-generate exactly one most likely condition, exactly two priority nursing actions, and exactly two monitoring or evaluation parameters. Return the required structured JSON and identify the stem evidence and any missing information needed for specificity or uniqueness.
stem: At 09:15, a 71-year-old client recovering from acute decompensated heart failure has an active 11:00 discharge order. She desaturates to 89% after walking 40 feet, requires oxygen to recover, fails teach-back about her new medications and warning signs, cannot afford the prescribed diuretic, lives alone in a second-floor walk-up apartment, and has no home scale. BNP and weight are improving. Complete the bow-tie to identify the priority condition, actions, and monitoring parameters.
